name: seo-audit
description: Audits one web page for on-page SEO and for readiness to be cited by AI answer engines. Paste the page's HTML (or give one URL, fetched through a strict guard that only reaches public addresses) and it returns a score computed in code, findings with severity and evidence quoted from the page, a prioritised fix list, and proposed title and meta description rewrites with their lengths measured in code. Follow-ups work on the stored audit: only critical, explain a finding, score breakdown, AI crawler rules, rewrite the title for a keyword, audit again with a new version. It never crawls a site, writes nothing, and does not report rankings, backlinks, traffic or page speed.

skills.name: Audit a page for SEO and AI search
skills.description: A code-computed SEO and AI-readiness score for one page (pasted HTML or one URL), findings with verbatim evidence, a fix list and title/meta rewrite proposals, plus follow-ups on the same audit.
examples: Here's my page's HTML, audit it for the keyword 'crm for startups': <paste>
Is this page ready for AI search engines? <URL>
